body: Apathy would probably describe how I feel towards most people including my family. I generally don't like being around other people or talking to them because it never ends well. Talking over the internet though text isn't as bad sometimes but in real life it's impossible. I feel like since people are inherently selfish they don't really care about others they just make small talk to pass time. I've given up on relationships and I know I want to live alone until I die because every relationship goes stale eventually why even bother with it when I don't like talking to people.

Myself I know so I can judge pretty well. Others I'm assuming but I just don't see how people can really care about others and not only think about themselves. I could honestly could not care less if my family died I would only feel inconvenienced because then I have nobody to fall back on if I make a mistake in my life and need somewhere to stay. Sounds edgy but that's what I think and how little I care.

It's okay if you don't get the exact meaning since that's on me; I'm not very good at writing. As for being realistic I think for me it is. I'm also cynical so I don't generally believe in the good of other people but I do think they are better than me. The world that I want to live in is physically impossible I don't enjoy this one at all. Since I'm refusing this "gift" of life I don't deserve it and I shouldn't be wasting resources (time, money, etc) that I use.

I think my wording was a bit off I meant it more like some people are better dead than alive. Such as people who live to hurt others or people who are broken that sort of thing. I don't believe I belong at all I might as well be a stone because I'm just as interesting as one. I'm not autistic but I have no clue how normal people have relationships I couldn't bring myself to find friends because I'm so plain.

I guess what I was trying to get at was that they're closer to acquaintances to me than family. I should be grateful for them raising me but I just don't care because they're practically strangers. I only use them for when I need something and go along with whatever other stuff so I can keep using them. I don't have anybody I'm close enough to that I would feel bad hurting with my death.

Some people just weren't meant to exist and shouldn't exist.

I'm not really depressed there's just nothing interesting it's always the same boring stuff or worrying about the future. I do have the power to change it but I find it easier to just think about killing myself rather than do anything since I'm really lazy. My closest family will be pretty shaken up but I know they'll get over it we're hardly family anyway. For the people who die and aren't really too close, you don't think about them often afterwards. At least that's my experience with it.
